data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word अंशित (Anshita), meaning 'Lord Ansh'. Ansh is a Hindu deity associated with cosmic power and the infinite universe. The name Ansit carries the meaning “Lord Ansh” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansit usually hope their child will grow to embody lord ansh and live with faith, good character and purpose.
